messages:
Sarah (Comms): @here all-hands in 20 — quick pre-checks. Streaming key rotated last night, right? Also the main mic in the booth got swapped to a loaner, curious about levels.
Mike (Infra): Yep key is the same for today. I cleared the cache on the encoder.
Leo (AV): We swapped mic B for mic A at 10:30 — loaner had ~-10dB gain. I can boost on the mixer but would prefer a physical swap back.
Sarah (Comms): Can someone confirm if we have backup slides for the roadmap bullets? Leadership wants 3 talking points only.
Anya (Product): I uploaded "allhands_roadmap_3bullets.pdf" to the drive and pinned it in the agenda thread. Use slide 2-4.
Sarah (Comms): Perfect, thanks. Leo — if you boost on the mixer, can you check plug-in latency? Last time there was an echo for the first 30s.
Leo (AV): Copy. I’ll set mixer gain +6dB and switch the EQ to the vocal preset. Doing a quick loopback now.
recording-bot: Recording will start in 5 minutes. Please keep mics muted until the host cue.
Mike (Infra): If the encoder needs a quick restart use: ```ssh encoder01 && sudo systemctl restart obs.service``` — brings streams back without full reboot.
Sarah (Comms): @Nadia do you want to address customer roadmap Qs live or have Anya handle the short clarifications? Nad (CEO): prefer live for 2 mins then hand to Anya for specifics.
Nadia (CEO): Quick note for the Q&A — call out the Dedicated SLA improvement and the Private deployment compliance checklist.
Anya (Product): Got it. I’ll have two bullets: SLA increase (99.9 -> 99.95) and new KMS integrations for Private.
Leo (AV): Mixer echo test done — looks clean. I still recommend swapping back to the original mic if it's available, loaner is fine but voices are slightly tinny.
Sarah (Comms): Ok action items: (1) Mike keep encoder command ready, (2) Leo swap mic if possible, (3) Anya and Nadia rehearse the 2-min live bit. Everyone react with :thumbsup: when you confirm.
Mike (Infra): :thumbsup:
Leo (AV): :thumbsup: swapping now
Anya (Product): :thumbsup: rehearsing with Nadia in 10
recording-bot: Recording started at 1967774600
Sarah (Comms): Thanks all — see you in the room.
